apps.name: SignOs
apps.localizedDescription: SignOs is an on-device signing store with App Store-style automatic updates, background signing and certificate renewal. Built on the open-source Feather project.
apps.subtitle: Automatic signing store

news.title: Welcome to SignOs
news.caption: SignOs signs and installs apps with your own certificates, keeps them updated automatically from your repositories, and re-signs apps before their certificates expire — all in the background, App Store style.
